subject: Re: Security & VPC discovery — SOC 2 / SSQ / deployment diagrams
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Security & VPC discovery — SOC 2 / SSQ / deployment diagrams

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for taking time on the call this morning — appreciate the clear overview of Acme's use case and security priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap:
- Acme is evaluating a private deployment (VPC peering or dedicated VPC) for inference to ensure network isolation and data residency.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 evidence, GDPR requirements for EU users, and potential HIPAA impact for a small subset of PII-driven workflows.
- You mentioned an internal security questionnaire (SSQ) and the need for a deployment diagram for your infra team.

Requested items from Acme (to help us finalize a Mutual Action Plan):
1) Current SOC 2 status (Type II in-progress vs. completed) + any SOC 2 summary you can share.
2) The vendor SSQ (we can fill this and return) — if you can share the template, we'll prioritize it.
3) Your network diagram / high-level infra view (especially how you plan to route traffic to a private VPC or whether an air-gapped option is required).

What we can provide quickly:
- Redwood SOC 2 summary + controls mapping (I'll attach a one-pager).
- A sample private deployment diagram showing VPC peering, NAT/egress control points, and data flow (I'll attach).
- A proposed timeline for a technical deep-dive with our infra engineer (we suggest 60 minutes, bring your network/security SME).

Next steps / ask:
- Can you send the SSQ and any internal checklist by end of week?
- If possible, share a network diagram or bullet list of firewall/egress requirements.
- I'll propose times for a technical deep-dive in a separate invite.

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 controls summary), redwood-deployment-diagram.png (sample private/VPC diagram)

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II certified for our core platform (report available under NDA). For our new data pipeline team there are scoped systems still being onboarded — happy to share the summary PDF.
- SSQ: I'll attach our SSQ (spreadsheet) — primarily standard controls + some network questions.
- Network diagram: attaching our current high-level network diagram (internal). We are currently evaluating whether we need full air-gapped deployment or if VPC peering with strict egress rules is sufficient. The main ask from our infra team is to see a proposed deployment that minimizes cross-VPC egress and supports optional on-prem/air-gap later.

We can do a technical deep-dive next Wednesday (Feb 25) — Kenji (cc) will lead from our infra team.

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & VPC discovery — SOC 2 / SSQ / deployment diagrams

Alicia,

Great — thanks for sending the SSQ and diagram. We reviewed the files and had a quick pass internally. High-level responses and proposed plan: 

1) SOC 2: We will provide our SOC 2 Type II summary and a mapping doc that points SSQ controls to Redwood evidence. Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. If needed we can execute an NDA to share more.

2) SSQ: We started filling the SSQ and have a few clarification questions in the "Notes" column. We'll upload the completed spreadsheet to your shared location by Monday.

3) Network / deployment options (summary):
   - Option A (recommended): Private VPC with VPC peering and strict egress controls. Redwood-managed nodes live in a customer-dedicated VPC, with traffic over peering or interface endpoints.
   - Option B: Dedicated on-prem appliance / air-gapped deployment — supported, but adds ~4–6 weeks for validation and deployment depending on your change windows.

Technical deep-dive proposal:
- Attendees: Marcus (solutions/infra), Kenji (Acme infra), Marissa (account), David (prod infra)
- Agenda: review network diagram, map firewall rules/egress, discuss KMS integration and audit log access, discuss timeline for SOC evidence exchange.
- Proposed times: Wed Feb 25 at 10:00am PT or Thu Feb 26 at 9:00am PT — what works?

Attachment stub: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on the call and walk through the deployment diagrams live.

Best,
Marcus
